extracted.name: Air Fryer Asparagus
extracted.description: Air fryer asparagus is easy to make for tender and crispy roast asparagus in minutes. The asparagus is topped with grated Parmesan cheese for a delicious side.
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Line the basket with parchment paper.
Place asparagus spears in the prepared basket and mist with avocado oil. Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and pepper flakes. Top with Parmesan cheese.
Air-fry until asparagus spears start to char, 7 to 9 minutes.
